    Args:

    """
    alpha = params[0]        # Oscillatory contant
    beta = params[1]          # Cubic nonlinear term

    lambda2 = params[4]        # Second higher-order (sextic/quadratic driving) term
    omega_d = params[5]       # Driving frequency parameter.
